pages.lesson:
LESSON: PRINT AWARENESS

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.3: Print Awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Print Awareness. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Talk about pictures in and out of school.
2. Demonstrate awareness of print in and out of school.
3. Show interest in reading in and out of school.
4. Enjoy reading pictures in and out of school. could ask and answer questions. bring pictures related to safe and unsafe places. bring their own pictures from home and talk about them. share pictures and books.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Talk about pictures in and out of school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to talk about pictures in and out of school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Demonstrate awareness of print in and out of school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate awareness of print in and out of school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Show interest in reading in and out of school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to show interest in reading in and out of school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. Enjoy reading pictures in and out of school. could ask and answer questions. bring pictures related to safe and unsafe places. bring their own pictures from home and talk about them. share pictures and books.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to enjoy reading pictures in and out of school. could ask and answer questions. bring pictures related to safe and unsafe places. bring their own pictures from home and talk about them. share pictures and books. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Print Awareness.
2. Explain Print Awareness to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Print Awareness.
4. Show that you can: Talk about pictures in and out of school.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Print Awareness. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Print Awareness important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Talk about pictures in and out of school.
2. Demonstrate awareness of print in and out of school.
3. Show interest in reading in and out of school.
4. Enjoy reading pictures in and out of school. could ask and answer questions. bring pictures related to safe and unsafe places. bring their own pictures from home and talk about them. share pictures and books.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
